hints.title: Problem Analysis
hints.text: A number has at least one trailing zero in its binary representation if and only if it is even.

hints.title: Key Observation
hints.text: The bitwise or of two numbers is even if and only if the least significant bit of both numbers is zero (both numbers are even).

hints.title: Algorithmic Strategy
hints.text: Therefore, check if the input array contains at least two even numbers.
